user.title: Painel de Energia (energy dashboard)
user.description:
Receives readings from the IE Tecnologia meter (SM-3W Lite / SM-W Lite) directly in Home Assistant.

The identifier below becomes part of the path typed into the meter and works like a password. You can keep the suggestion.

error.invalid_id: Use 4 to 48 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, no spaces.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Several meters share one integration: give each a different device ID.

create_entry.default:
Done. In the meter's settings page (NUVEM section), enable transmission, choose **Tipo de envio: Padrão** and fill in:

- Protocolo: `HTTP POST (Variáveis Payload Único)`
- IP ou Domínio do Servidor: `{server}`
- Caminho: `{path}`
- Porta: `{port}`
- Interval: `30` seconds

The same data is shown in the panel, in the sidebar as **Painel de Energia**.

data.sidebar: Show the panel in the sidebar
data.local_only: Accept readings from the local network only
data.listen_port: Dedicated port for the meter (0 = off)
data.counter_unit: Unit of the meter's energy counters
data.offline_after_s: Seconds without readings before the meter is considered offline
data.raw_retention_days: Days of individual readings kept (0 = forever)
data.max_power_kw: Highest possible power of the installation (kW)

data_description.listen_port: Opens a plain HTTP port that accepts any path. Use it if Home Assistant only serves HTTPS.
data_description.mqtt_topic: Only if the meter sends over MQTT; uses the broker of Home Assistant's MQTT integration.
data_description.counter_unit: Keep kWh. Change only if the panel warns that the counters seem to be in Wh.
